video_title: What If Every Lie Left a Mark on Your Face?
video_description: An original five-minute speculative animated moral drama. Noah wishes liars could be recognized immediately. In this fictional world an intentional lie draws a magenta crack on the speaker's cheek; admitting it erases it. He exposes a self-serving bully and enjoys the applause. Then he gives a child a cruel but technically true verdict and sees that a clean face can still hurt someone. At a hospital his mother lies that she is not frightened. His own denial of wanting applause marks his face. The resolution is an honest apology and choosing helpful, compassionate truth, rather than policing everyone else. Cool violet city, large faces, dynamic physical acting, ink spreading and clearing, public confrontation, a torn drawing, rain and an intimate hospital reconciliation. Sparse speech, cinematic action and expressive reactions. The premise and consequences are fiction, not psychology claims.
